intro.en: This indicator is meant to capture households whose income is irregular or very low: households led by one adult or by children, older persons without a pension, people who are paid by the day and people with disabilities who cannot find work. INFORM Tanzania carries no data for it yet; councils can fill it from the TASAF, social welfare and community registers. A high score would mean that many households have no cushion at all when work stops. Lead sectors: finance and planning; industry and trade.
intro.sw: Kiashiria hiki kimekusudiwa kuonyesha kaya zenye kipato kisicho cha uhakika au kidogo sana: kaya zinazoongozwa na mtu mzima mmoja au na watoto, wazee wasio na pensheni, watu wanaolipwa kwa siku na watu wenye ulemavu wasiopata kazi. INFORM Tanzania bado haina data yake; halmashauri zinaweza kuijaza kutoka rejista za TASAF, ustawi wa jamii na jamii. Alama ya juu ingemaanisha kuwa kaya nyingi hazina kinga yoyote kazi inaposimama. Sekta zinazoongoza: fedha na mipango; viwanda na biashara.

impact.en: Day workers, small traders and boda boda riders lose their income on the days that rain, floods or closures stop work
impact.sw: Vibarua, wafanyabiashara wadogo na waendesha bodaboda hukosa kipato siku ambazo mvua, mafuriko au kufungwa kwa shughuli husimamisha kazi

en: Put a little aside on good days, in a savings group or mobile money, for the days work stops.
Market and stand leaders: agree in advance where traders can move their goods when water rises.
Council trade officers: allow temporary trading places during a hazard so that incomes continue.
sw: Weka akiba kidogo siku nzuri, kwenye kikundi cha kuweka na kukopa au pesa za simu, kwa ajili ya siku kazi inaposimama.
Viongozi wa masoko na vituo: kubalianeni mapema wafanyabiashara wataweka wapi bidhaa zao maji yanapopanda.
Maafisa biashara wa halmashauri: ruhusuni maeneo ya muda ya biashara wakati wa janga ili kipato kiendelee.

impact.en: Older persons without a pension and households led by children have no one to replace lost food or housing
impact.sw: Wazee wasio na pensheni na kaya zinazoongozwa na watoto hawana wa kuwarejeshea chakula au makazi yaliyopotea

en: Neighbours and faith groups: know these households by name and check on them before, during and after a hazard.
Social welfare officers and TASAF: keep these households on the registers and make sure they receive their entitlements first.
Village committees: include at least one older person and one young person in the committee, so that their needs are heard.
sw: Majirani na vikundi vya kidini: zifahamuni kaya hizi kwa majina na zitembeleeni kabla, wakati na baada ya janga.
Maafisa ustawi wa jamii na TASAF: wekeni kaya hizi kwenye rejista na hakikisheni zinapata stahiki zao kwanza.
Kamati za kijiji: mjumuishe angalau mzee mmoja na kijana mmoja kwenye kamati, ili mahitaji yao yasikike.

impact.en: People with disabilities may be left out of work, information and relief unless this is planned for
impact.sw: Watu wenye ulemavu wanaweza kuachwa nje ya kazi, taarifa na misaada isipopangwa makusudi

en: Ask people with disabilities what they need to work, move and receive information, and plan with them, not for them.
Committees: keep relief and registration points reachable for wheelchairs and give information in spoken, written and sign form.
Council: link people with disabilities to the disability loan fund, skills training and assistive devices.
sw: Waulize watu wenye ulemavu wanahitaji nini ili kufanya kazi, kutembea na kupata taarifa, na panga pamoja nao, si kwa niaba yao.
Kamati: hakikisheni vituo vya misaada na usajili vinafikika kwa viti vya magurudumu na toeni taarifa kwa maneno, maandishi na lugha ya alama.
Halmashauri: unganisheni watu wenye ulemavu na mfuko wa mikopo ya watu wenye ulemavu, mafunzo ya ujuzi na vifaa saidizi.
